basic_profile.bio: I've been lurking around Reddit for over a decade, mostly exploring various topics that pique my interest. Based in a small town in the Midwest, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me flexible hours. I'm single and enjoy cooking gourmet meals, especially trying out new recipes. I dislike rigid routines and prefer spontaneous adventures or deep dives into random facts. I usually browse Reddit late at night when inspiration for my designs runs low.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in visual arts, but most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and experimenting with different design tools. I also have a keen interest in culinary arts, which is purely a hobby I've developed through online tutorials and cookbooks.
